material.ruleHome: You can collect a track in the home pond or mint it here. The two don't conflict, and both are recorded under “My music”.
material.ruleEth: On Ethereum, each wallet can mint a given track only once in total, and transferring it out doesn't restore eligibility. There's no supply cap per track, and minting itself is free.
material.ruleOp: On Optimism it's a non-transferable SBT and the platform pays the gas. On Ethereum it's a transferable NFT, and you pay the gas from your own wallet.
